entities.summary: Andrzej Tadeusz Kapiszewski (1948–2007) was a Polish sociologist and diplomat. Member of the Polish Academy of Sciences, professor at the Jagiellonian University, one of the creators of the Faculty of International and Political Relations and Chair of Middle and Far East Studies. Founder and first rector of the private academy in Kraków.
